content: 1. Matrix Multiplication Fundamentals Matrix multiplication is a row-by-column binary operation. Two matrices A and B can only be multiplied if the number of columns in A equals the number of rows in B . If A has dimension m \times k and B has dimension k \times n , then the product C = AB has dimension m \times n . subject: physics
excerpt: Concise summary of the Zeroth, First, and Second Laws of Thermodynamics, state functions, and Carnot cycle equations.
content: 1. The Four Laws in Brief Zeroth Law : If system A is in thermal equilibrium with B , and B is with C , then A is in thermal equilibrium with C . This establishes the definition of temperature. First Law : \Delta U = Q - W Where \Delta U is the change in internal energy, Q is heat added to the system, and W is work done by the system .
